name: run_command
description: Execute a shell command in the project directory. Timeout: 5 minutes. Use for installing packages (npm install, pip install), one-shot build scripts, git operations, and general terminal tasks. IMPORTANT: Do NOT use this to read files (use read_file), search files (use search_files/semantic_search), or start dev/preview servers (npm run dev, npm start, vite, npx serve, etc.) — WizardGenie has a built-in preview; starting a server will hang the agent. This is a Windows environment — use PowerShell or cmd-compatible commands only (no wc, grep, cat, etc.). Use node -e for cross-platform one-liners.
